description: UNTESTED against a real Rex (written from the rex CLI calls of a working helper script). Each run in its own Rex window in the runner's session ($REX_SESSION), named after the session. Starts an interactive shell and types the agent command into it, so shell aliases work; the shell exits with the agent. The agent state comes from the block's program_status. Needs rex and jq on PATH, and every command (including finish, run by the agent) to run inside the same Rex session.
close: w=$(rex block inspect -s "$1" "$2" --json | jq -r '.block.window_id // empty') && [ -n "$w" ] && rex window close -s "$1" "$w"
status: rex block inspect -s "$1" "$2" --json >/dev/null || exit 1; rex block call -s "$1" -b "$2" program_status 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.records[0].state // empty'
attach: w=$(rex block inspect -s "$1" "$2" --json | jq -r '.block.window_id // empty') && [ -n "$w" ] && rex focus -s "$1" "$w"
